The basketball court was closed after 10pm.
Between what times could Emily have gone to the basketball court?

Options:
(A) 3pm to 6pm
(B) 12pm to 2pm
(C) 6pm to 8pm
(D) 2pm to 3pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
